summary: TIM S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K with the SEC on September 11, 2026, dated September 10, 2026, containing only cover-page, signature, and graphic/exhibit material with no substantive disclosure of any corporate transaction. The filing names CEO Alberto Mario Griselli as signatory; no stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing timetable appears. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activism, spin-off, or capital-return event is disclosed. For event-driven purposes this is an administrative foreign-private-issuer report with no deal terms and no risk-arb angle to monitor.
